itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 9, 2026
itens.resumo: We’ve launched Claude Fable 5.2 ( claude-fable-5-2 ), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Claude Mythos 5.2 ( claude-mythos-5-2 ) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic’s verification programs, such as the Cyber Verification Program . Both models have a 1M token context window , 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking . They cost $8 USD per MTok of input and $40 USD per MTok of output (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $10 USD per MTok of input and $50 USD per MTok of output). Claude Fable 5.2 is available on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS , and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) . It’s also available on Claude in Amazon Bedrock . It’s also available on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) . It’s also available on Claude in Microsoft Foundry . See What’s new in Claud

itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 5, 2026
itens.resumo: You can now set up an IP allowlist for your organization in the Claude Console, in beta. Requests to covered services from addresses not on your list are refused, which limits where a leaked API key can be used. Add IPv4 and IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges, up to 1,000 per organization. See IP allowlisting for what’s covered and how to set it up. You can now sign a member of your Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) organization out of Claude everywhere with the Admin API. This capability is in beta. See the Admin API reference . The member stays in the organization and can sign in again. See Sign a member out everywhere for the beta header and what the request doesn’t end.

itens.resumo: Text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on the platforms listed in How Claude marks AI-generated content . On Claude Sonnet 4.6, text generated for a request that sets temperature , top_p , or top_k to a non-default value might not carry it. See Text watermark .

itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 2, 2026
itens.resumo: Long conversations and agent loops on the Messages API can now send smaller requests and get a lower time to first token with message threads , in beta with the message-threads-2026-08-12 beta header. The API keeps the conversation on the server, so each later request sends only the new messages. A thread expires 5 minutes after its last request and is deleted no more than 1 hour after its last use. Message threads are available on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS , Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), and Claude in Microsoft Foundry .
